alt.en: The displayed accented e can be U+00E9, encoded as C3 A9, or U+0065 followed by U+0301, encoded as 65 CC 81. NFC merges these into the composed form. In cafe plus combining accent then space 750, the number begins at code-point index 6 before normalization and 5 after it.
alt.zh-hans: 屏幕上的带重音字母 e 可以是 U+00E9，对应字节 C3 A9；也可以是 U+0065 后接 U+0301，对应 65 CC 81。NFC 把两者统一为预组合形式。在 cafe 后接组合重音、空格和 750 的文本中，数字在规范化前从码点下标 6 开始，规范化后从 5 开始。

caption.en: Figure 8.1 — Canonical matching can improve while original offsets stop matching.
caption.zh-hans: 图 8.1 — 规范化可以改善匹配，却让原文位置不再对应。

label.en: Two encodings of an accented letter
label.zh-hans: 同一个重音字母的两种表示

flow.en: NFC gives U+00E9 for both. It does not recover which original representation was used.
flow.zh-hans: 两者经 NFC 都得到 U+00E9，却无法据此还原最初用了哪种表示。

label.en: An extraction offset is tied to a representation
label.zh-hans: 抽取位置依赖具体表示

text.en: Raw: c a f e ◌́ ␠ 7 5 0; 750 starts at 6
text.zh-hans: 原文：c a f e ◌́ ␠ 7 5 0；750 从 6 开始

text.en: NFC: c a f é ␠ 7 5 0; 750 starts at 5
text.zh-hans: NFC 后：c a f é ␠ 7 5 0；750 从 5 开始
